item.tib: bka' rgyud kyi man ngag nyams len du dril ba
item.coloph: rin chen phreng ba'i zab don/ bder gshegs rnams kyi dgongs nyams/ rigs 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud/ mtshan ldan drung mu'i snyan rgyud/ drin can bla ma rnams kyi mdzad srol/ slob dpon gong ma rnams kyi phyag len/ skal ldan rnams kyi nye lam/ 'gro la sman pa'i gdams ngag thar par 'dren pa'i skas lam/ 'dzin blo gcod pa'i spu gri/ bro rnam 'byed pa'i lde mig dug lnga nyon mongs kyi gnyen po/ bka' rgyud sil bu'i man ngag nyams len du dril ba 'di ni/ gong ma rnams phyag len dang / khyad par drin can bla ma'i (mchan/ nag 'gu g.yung drung rgyal mtshan) gsungs bzhin mdo gam rgyal ri dkar po'i mdun zhol du/ gong btsun bla ma nam mkha' lhun grub kyi (kyis) sbyar ba dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/
